canary_environment_contract.SCHEDULEURM_ALGORITHM: theorem_maxweight_v1 when enabled through scheduler dispatch
canary_environment_contract.SCHEDULEURM_ORACLE_TRACE_PATH: required JSONL path for dispatch slots

large_scale_organic_launched_completion_: legacy alias for strict history completion in this controlled gate; use history_large_scale_completion_ready or live_trace_large_scale_completion_ready
minimum_candidate_count_semantics: The theorem-facing requirement is a nonempty finite candidate family per launched slot plus exact robust MaxWeight selection; multiple candidates per slot are diagnostic richness, not a MaxWeight stability assumption.
pass_meaning: 32-task controlled launched completion is closed.  The strict scheduler-history large-scale completion certificate is also closed as a separate evidence path; live oracle-traced large-scale completion remains false
scope: Recognizes existing bounded controlled launched completion evidence and defines the stronger 32-task controlled threshold.  Strict history completion and live-trace completion are separate fields. It only launches additional controlled tasks when explicitly allowed and GPU utilization is below the safety threshold.
